facts.text: Product: Duropedic Airboost 6.8 Arctic Ice Mattress.
Selected configuration: Queen, 78 x 60 in (198 x 152 cm), 8 in (20.3 cm) high.
Airboost is described as Duroflex’s proprietary open-matrix mattress technology, made from over one lakh independently responsive fibres.
The product title identifies the material combination as Airknit fibres with latex.
The mattress has a reversible latex topper with firm support on one side and medium-firm support on the other.
Flip the mattress to switch between firmness levels.
The zipper cover can be removed and helps identify each side.
The mattress features a 6-inch Airboost layer combined with latex.
Arctic Ice is described as a cooling fabric used on select Airboost models.
The zipper cover is machine washable; softer wash settings are recommended to increase durability.
The product title advertises a 100-nights trial.
The product FAQ describes a 100-day sleep trial. The page’s 100-day and 100-night trial units conflict.
The product-page banner displays a 10-year warranty; the duration is unresolved because the FAQ gives a variant-dependent 7–10-year range.
The Airboost warranty FAQ gives a duration of 7–10 years depending on variant; the applicable duration for this selected configuration is unresolved.
The manufacturer warranty covers manufacturing defects and material issues under normal-use conditions; the FAQ does not specify the duration in this coverage statement.
The 8-inch profile is described as fitting most standard bed frames, including storage beds and low-profile designs.
